title: Support Center
subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about GeoAnalyzer

general.q: How does GeoAnalyzer differ from competitors?
general.a: We are unique in our approach. Competitors show 'where', while we answer the question 'how is it to live there?'. We don't just display objects; we aggregate them into ratings of safety, comfort, and investment attractiveness, saving you dozens of hours of independent research.

general.q: What coverage does the service have?
general.a: Currently, we are entering the Polish market. We are constantly striving to add new locations. If you haven't found the city you need, please wait a little while. Our goal is to cover as many settlements as possible so everyone can find exactly what they are looking for.

general.q: Can I use the service on mobile?
general.a: Yes, our interface is fully responsive. You can explore neighborhoods from your laptop at home or from your smartphone while visiting a property.

subscription.a: This is a unique offer for those in the active phase of house hunting. You get full Premium functionality for a symbolic fee for 7 days, which is usually enough to choose an apartment.

subscription.q: What are White Label reports in the Realtor Pro plan?
subscription.a: This feature allows real estate agents to generate PDF reports about a neighborhood without the GeoAnalyzer logo. You can add your own contacts and branding, providing clients with professional analytics under your own name.

data.a: We use cross-verification of data from multiple authoritative sources. However, a city is a living organism, and changes happen daily. If you need a detailed data collection methodology for a specific district, please send a request to our email.

data.q: Where does the safety information come from?
data.a: The safety index is formed based on official crime statistics, street lighting data, the presence of CCTV cameras, and proximity to police stations.

data.q: How often is the database updated?
data.a: Real estate prices and environmental indicators are updated in near real-time. Infrastructural changes (new shops, bus stops) are updated according to the schedule of primary registries.

account.q: How do I contact technical support?
account.a: For prompt resolution of issues, use the feedback form on the 'Contacts' page or email us at youworkday@gmail.com. We respond within 24 hours.
